requirements.must_show_app_note: At least one slide must be a full-bleed screenshot of the app. Reviewers reject sets that only talk about it.

rules.tone: First person. Speak like a lifter, not a brand. No exclamation marks.
rules.disclosure: #ad must appear in the caption, not in the slides.

assets_supplied_by_agency.note: Clipper supplies their own footage. Agency supplies app screens and the palette only.

brief.audience: 18-27 men who already train 3-5x a week and track nothing
brief.insight: They think they are progressing because the weight feels heavier. They have no idea whether it actually went up.
brief.angle: Rank the things that actually drive progress, put the app in as the thing that shows you the answer.
brief.payload: A ranked list with a rating out of 10 and a one-line verdict, counted down so the swipe pays off at the end.

compliance_notes: Rate is per 1,000 views, paid after a 9 day review window.
Views on reposted or duplicated sets are not counted.
A set missing the required mention is rejected outright, not edited.
